# Print-failure fixtures

Source: **Alex-Ultra/3d-cli-print-failure-frames** on Hugging Face
<https://huggingface.co/datasets/Alex-Ultra/3d-cli-print-failure-frames>
License: **CC-BY-4.0** (frames are the owner's own captures).

Subset copied here:

- `spaghetti/` — the seven frames labelled `spaghetti`
  (`202230bd618c1bff`, `6f934369014dceec`, `8d0d738bdf01924a`,
  `bca31f6a16d7c9e2`, `cc7407c00ae00b5b`, `ce783d8af91174f6`,
  `ea07bc1c4b921cef`).
- `healthy/` — five frames labelled `healthy`
  (`003cc04621b237b7`, `015c00c884f8042b`, `020f00dc84f57b8a`,
  `022a0d1842ce22b9`, `0294c94498d5b124`).

They are used only to check that the shipped Obico model separates a whole-frame
failure from a healthy print. Attribution: Alex-Ultra, *3d-cli print-failure
frames*, CC-BY-4.0.
